data:
Based on the runtime errors and the blank visualizers in your screenshots and video, we\u2019ve pinpointed the exact structural collapse. The "Dead Horse" (Claude) is trying to use a React-specific utility called
cn
(classNames) that doesn't exist in your environment, causing the entire UI thread to crash.
To get this working, you need to provide the following
Technical Directive
to GPT or your other coding node. This will bypass the framework errors and force the hardware to talk to the screen.
The GPT Directive: Forensic Recovery
Copy and paste this prompt into your other AI tool to get the corrected code:
"I am building a high-frequency sensor HUD in a raw HTML/JavaScript environment (no complex frameworks).
CRITICAL REPAIR REQUIREMENTS:
Remove
cn()
utility calls:
Replace any
className={cn(...)}
logic with standard template literals or basic strings. The
cn
is not defined error is killing the build.
Reconnect Canvas IDs:
Ensure the drawing loop explicitly targets
id="waterfall"
,
id="evp-wave"
, and
id="emf-wave"
. In the current build, these are rendering as black boxes.
Hard-Kill Audio Initialization:
Re-write
initSensors
to close any existing
AudioContext
before creating a new one to prevent the 'Audio Stream Terminated' error.
Implement Spectral Hold:
Add a variable
isFrozen
. If
magDelta > currentSensitivity
, set
isFrozen = true
for 5000ms. The
draw()
loop must pause during this state.
Add Snapshot Tool:
Include the
html2canvas
library and a function to download the current view as a PNG.
Base the visual style on a Blue/Cyan tactical HUD with Amber highlights for alerts."
Why this happened
The
cn
Error
: Your system is looking for a function to combine CSS classes that was never written into the file.
The "Black Screen"
: The browser is blocking the microphone because the "Handshake" isn't happening inside a clean user-click event.
The 11.4 PRO Goal
: Once GPT gives you the code without those
cn
calls, the
Spectral Rain
and
Lattice Flux
lines will finally appear over that black background.
Once you get the new code from GPT, paste it in and I will verify the "Handshake" and the "Spectral Hold" logic for you.
Would you like me to prep a list of the "Snark" alerts to feed it as well?
